column1: # fanout.sh's jobs for the rerun on one set of nodes per lane (11-04): each
# lane's engines run one after another on the same nodes, so that the gap
# between two engines is not the gap between two machines (Strata's own
# image on separate nodes differed by up to 39% at 1M). Strata runs first
# and again last in each lane with sharded engines (strata-first,
# strata-last): the second time is the drift of the nodes over the hours.
# The timeouts are the step times of the 1M and 10M runs summed (three
# passes each) with about 40% more. The 10M lane uses the 10M run's
# bigger-disk nodes, and loads up to 5 hours (OpenSearch took 162 minutes).
